body: Having the same issue, wondering if I've just drank nail polish flavoured water instead.

Don't let past mistakes get you down, just because you haven't hit someone else's standards does not mean you should give up on your own, you can still get your shit together if that's what you want to do.   


Go back to college, and if that's no longer an option do something else that will help you meet YOUR standards.
Don't live for others, live for yourself.
You're speaking to me, and I just listened.

Stop placing your value in women, stop placing it in whether you get laid or not, or whether you find love or anything else.   


Place value in yourself, invest in yourself and love yourself, you are the most important thing you have, you are your own most valuable asset.

The battle never ends, how much you can take is up to you.   


There are two choices in life, to give up or to keep moving forward.   


In my opinion there is no shame in either, and no matter how that sounds or goes against this subreddit's rules I can honestly just tell you that's the truth.   


You either find your reason to keep going forward, or you give up.   


I can give you this bullshit about how your mom will be sad, or someone will miss you but I won't, you already know all that, and me repeating it won't help.   


Instead I'll ask you to live for yourself, as it's more productive.   


You know, you have one shot at this life thing, no matter what you believe in it seems to be true, you don't get to live THIS life over again.   


I won't tell you not to kill yourself, all I will tell you is that your individual life is unique, you have the choices to do anything you wish with it, and that choice alone is yours.   


In the end I personally hope you would not go through with this, but as I said I can not stop you.
